site.locationName: Dobi Talo Stadium, Bhiwandi, Thane, Maharashtra, India

coach.name: Coach Vikram Rathore
coach.role: Founder & Head Coach, Thunder Strike Combat Club
coach.bio: Coach Vikram has spent over a decade on both sides of the mat — first as a competitive Wushu athlete, then as the coach who built Thunder Strike from a single rented hall into a full multi-discipline combat academy. His training blends traditional Wushu Sanda and Taolu with Taekwondo, Karate, Judo and Wrestling fundamentals, plus dedicated strength and weight-loss coaching for adults. Every student, from a nervous first-timer to a state-squad hopeful, gets the same hands-on attention.
credentials: 15+ years of competitive & coaching experience across multiple combat disciplines
Specialist in Wushu Sanda full-contact fighting
Cross-trained and certified in Taekwondo, Karate, Judo & Wrestling
Dedicated Weight Loss & Strength Training programs for adults
Regularly follows international Wushu tournaments and rule updates via IWUF
